name: Witherspring Wilds
description:
About This Game

The wilds are dangerous, but also bountiful. Only a few humans arrived in this new world, but you’re all ready to make it your home and start a new village. Taming these lands is not for you alone, but for those that come after as well. There’s far too much to do in one lifetime.

Witherspring Wilds is an open world life sim that goes beyond any you have seen before. With boundless options - farming, mining, crafting, building, combat, exploration, alchemy, creature taming and more - how will you shape the world?

There’s no right or wrong way to play - if you want to experience Witherspring Wilds as a cozy farming game, you can. If you want to play it as an action packed exploration open world, you can. And if you want to focus on making connections, there are NPCs to befriend, handle jobs for you, fight alongside you and even romance.

Features

  • Build - Build and customize your home and village. You can even create your own store to sell to NPCs (and visit stores NPCs have built).

  • Befriend - You can befriend and trade with NPCs, but also give them jobs like watering your crops or building your house. You can adventure together and deepen your bonds, become best friends or even get married and have kids.

  • Explore - Different biomes have vastly different plants, animals and materials. Some regions even have higher star levels for higher quality materials but also more dangerous enemies.

  • Craft - Create delicious meals, improved tools, clothes, armor, potions, magic wands and more!

  • Fight - Use swords, bows and magic wands to defend yourself from dangerous creatures and hunt powerful bosses.

  • Tame - Any natural creature can be tamed and will have various benefits as a pet - from riding Goxen to having a Cattern defend you in battle.

  • Farm - Cultivate wild plants and trees to stockpile food and materials.

  • Mine - Mine inside mountains to find ores, caves and mushrooms.

And so much more!

Who are We?

We’re Fancy Fish Games - a small indie team that has released 16 games, 8 commercially on Steam, since 2012. We follow our passion, making games that catch our fancy - our games tend to be quirky, surprising or thought-provoking.
short_desc: Reincarnate into a new open world full of danger and opportunity. Start from nothing and build a village as you advance science and magic. Farm, fight, craft, explore, tame creatures - how will you shape the Wilds?
